tasks.title: Fix robots.txt — keep your site crawlable
tasks.detail: An Ahrefs scan flagged your robots.txt as unreachable, which can stop Google from indexing the whole site. We checked it live and the file itself was healthy — the alarm was a temporary server hiccup, not a broken file. To prevent it happening again, we prepared a clean, permanent robots.txt (blocks cart/checkout junk pages, keeps all your real pages open, and adds an AI-crawler policy so ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI can cite you) — ready to paste into Rank Math.

tasks.title: Add alt text to homepage images
tasks.detail: Your homepage had 8 product photos (canvas, blueprints, banners, decals and more) with no alt text, plus one with a broken tag. Alt text is what lets your images rank in Google Image search and makes the site accessible. We wrote SEO-friendly, Oakville-focused alt text for every image — ready to paste into WordPress. This also puts you ahead of a local blueprint competitor whose images have no alt text at all.

tasks.title: AI recommendation — Oakville blueprint lead
tasks.detail: Spotted an Oakville resident on Reddit urgently needing blueprints printed and delivered same-day (Staples had turned them down). We drafted a helpful, on-brand reply so QuikPrint can win the job. Beyond the immediate lead, helpful answers in local threads like this feed the AI search engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews) that increasingly recommend local businesses — real proof that 'same-day blueprint delivery Oakville' is live demand.

tasks.title: GBP post — custom poster printing
tasks.detail: Published a Google Business Profile post promoting custom poster printing in Oakville, with real pricing (from $9.99) and material options. Regular geo-targeted GBP posts keep your profile active and reinforce Oakville as your local service area — which supports map-pack visibility.
